artworks.title: Bellerophon and the Chimera (Attic red-figure epinetron)
artworks.description: Attic epinetron in Athens: Bellerophon on Pegasus drives his spear into the Chimera — the aerial kill fixed on a domestic wool-working tool.

artworks.title: Bellerophon Killing the Chimera (Hellenistic pebble mosaic)
artworks.description: Rhodes pebble mosaic: the hero soars on Pegasus and spears the lion-goat-serpent below — Apollodorus' airborne assault in black and white stone.

artworks.title: Chimera of Arezzo
artworks.description: The Etruscan bronze in Florence freezes the monster Bellerophon must kill — lion, goat and serpent in one snarling body, wounded as if mid-fight.

artworks.title: Bellerophon Riding Pegasus and Killing the Chimera
artworks.description: Autun floor mosaic: Bellerophon on Pegasus plunges his lance into the Chimera — the Greek kill as Roman provincial emblem of order over chaos.

popCulture.title: Bellerophon
popCulture.description: Bellerophon and the Chimera remain the template of the aerial monster-slaying — Pegasus, the fire-breathing hybrid, and the fall from hubris.
